snippet.title: Astra Protocol Remake - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Astra Protocol Remake is a retro inspired, sci-fi space simulator.

Your headquarters have been destroyed. Your allies are gone. You have no resources and are alone in the hostile reaches of outer space. The final words of your command linger in your memory - Initiate Astra Protocol.

Astra Protocol Remake is a survival game where you pilot a spacecraft on limited resources, attempting to last  as long as possible. You must carefully manage your fuel, shields, and arsenal whilst navigating asteroids and avoiding hostile spacecraft.

A remake of the original game that launched in 2020, Astra Protocol Remake features an entirely new engine, bringing with it graphical enhancements, improved enemy AI and tweaked game logic.

Astra Protocol Remake is available FREE on PC from itch.io: https://slicebar.itch.io/astra-protocol-remake

#gaming #indiegame #scifi
